other.powersofarrest:
Arrest without warrant
Under paragraph 11(3) of Schedule 4A to the immigration Act 1971 a relevant officer may arrest without warrant anyone whom the officer has reasonable grounds for suspecting to be guilty of an offence under paragraph 11.
other.penalty:
Fifty one weeks imprisonment and / or a fine

Note:
Until the provisions of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 are brought into force, the maximum sentence that the magistrates can impose is 6 months. There is no expected 'in force' date at present.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
